READ                                                    Traveller
   Read the e-mail and write T for True or F for False.



                     alfierobertson@yahoo.co.uk

                   leefthompson@gmail.com@yahoo.co.uk


      Hi Alfie,
       I’m free for lunch tomorrow, so let’s go somewhere nice for a change.

       Charlton’s has got lovely food. My sister goes there every Friday for lunch. They serve hot and
       cold food and they’re open from 8am to 8pm.

       There’s also Abuela’s in the town centre. They’ve got traditional Mexican food. I really want to go
       there. Do you like Mexican food?

       Or, we can go to Dolmia’s for some pizza. Pizza isn’t really my favourite food, but you always
      enjoy it so, we can go there.

       Let me know what you think,

      Lee


     1. Lee’s sister has lunch at Charlton’s every Friday.

     2. Charlton’s opens at eight in the evening.

     3. Abuela’s is a Mexican restaurant.
     4. Pizza is Lee’s favourite food.                                           SCORE     8
